title: Monero GUI settings
whyItMatters: The Monero GUI folder holds wallet cache and configuration. Wallet files reveal that Monero was used and may point to keys stored elsewhere.
source: Elastic detection-rules macOS wallet paths reference ~/Library/Application Support/monero-wallet-gui - https://github.com/elastic/detection-rules/issues/6616
notes: Settings folder only; wallets default to ~/Monero/wallets (see wallet.monero-gui.wallets). Unconfirmed for current GUI builds.

steps: Confirm you have the recovery phrase or backup for every Monero wallet you used with this app.
Quit Monero GUI so its settings are not in use.
Delete the monero-wallet-gui folder named in the plan, then empty the Trash.
cleanup.risk: Settings and the wallet cache leave this Mac. Wallet files stored elsewhere are handled by their own step.
